mode: Windows Terminal through detached no-activate helper
observation: The target window generated one foreground notification, but every notification reported the initiating window as the actual foreground window; the target was never sampled as foreground.
focusGuard: The helper restores the initiating foreground window for a bounded 2500 ms guard and stops early when GetLastInputInfo detects user input, so an intentional user switch is respected.
limitations: Windows Terminal remains an external window manager; no OS-level universal focus guarantee is claimed.
This probe verifies startup with no target foreground samples and automatic closure, not every possible third-party focus policy.
